summary: The registrant, Madison Air Solutions Corp, filed an 8-K solely to disclose a Seventh Amendment to its existing Credit and Guaranty Agreement. The amendment reduces the interest rate spread on an incremental term loan facility from SOFR +2.75% to SOFR +1.75%. No other terms changed. This is a routine financial obligation adjustment, not a special situation. There is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, or other transformative event. The filing reflects ordinary course debt management. No watch items or risk-arb angles apply.
